summary_en: This phase II study tests isatuximab, belantamab mafodotin, pomalidomide, and dexamethasone together in relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma. Isatuximab and belantamab mafodotin are given into a vein, and pomalidomide and dexamethasone are taken by mouth; each cycle is 28 days. The study measures overall response rate.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa isatuximab, belantamab mafodotina, pomalidomida y dexametasona juntos en mieloma múltiple recidivante y refractario. Isatuximab y belantamab mafodotina se administran por vena, y la pomalidomida y la dexametasona se toman por vía oral; cada ciclo dura 28 días. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta global.
who_for: ECOG performance status of 2 or lower.
Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after at least one prior line of therapy.
Prior lenalidomide and proteasome inhibitor therapy, with disease progression on or within 60 days of last therapy.
Blood counts, kidney, and liver function within limits set by the study.
not_for: Prior anti-CD38 antibody therapy within six months.
Active plasma cell leukemia, POEMS syndrome, or primary AL amyloidosis.
